item.title: Someone allegedly used a hairdryer to rig Polymarket weather bets
item.description:
📝 Big Tech Someone allegedly used a hairdryer to rig Polymarket weather bets It has been suggested that they snuck in with the appliance and blew it on a temperature sensor. The site is still running bets on the daily temperature in and around Paris. It sucks that someone potentially tricked a temperature sensor with a hairdryer to scam actual gamblers out of potential winnings.
🔗 Read more: https://www.engadget.com/big-tech/someone-allegedly-used-a-hairdryer-to-rig-polymarket-weather-bets-155312411.html
